assets.name: train-body
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Children's painted spelling game sprite. Repaint reference 1 in the subtle soft pencil and gouache of reference 2, retaining the reference 1 EXACT stretched two-carriage side elevation with front to the right, red-and-cream passenger livery, blue windows, two roof vents and central flexible bellows. Keep the silhouette, longitudinal spacing, relative length/height, roof contour, doors, and exact four pairs of wheel positions. Design so separate wheels can be drawn underneath the body. The full body fits very wide left to right, minimal clear margins, no perspective, no floor, shadow, text, labels or logos. Real transparent alpha in place of all magenta, no pink pixels.
